English: Spindle Stand
A humble arrangement of crude wooden stands and baskets where nomads spin raw fibers into thread by hand, marking the beginnings of textile craft among the clan.
Weavers Bench
A sturdier, portable bench and awning for the clans best spinners and weavers, improving thread production and light textile work on the move.
Loom Hut
A semi-permanent felt hut with a simple loom, allowing for the weaving of cloth for both clothing and tents, vital for nomadic survival.
Threading Pavilion
A large, communal tent with multiple looms, benches, and supply racks. Here, skilled workers create thread and simple cloth for the clans growing needs.
Dyehouse
A specialized tent for mixing natural dyes, allowing the creation of colored cloth. The presence of skilled dye-masters enhances trade and clan pride.
Patterned Loom Room
A caravan tent set aside for advanced patterned weaving, producing intricate textiles prized by traders and nobility alike.
Fine Weavers Hall
A grand tented hall where master weavers oversee the production of luxury textiles. Attracts skilled artisans and increases the clans prestige.
Textile Chamber
A well-appointed chamber within a semi-permanent structure, housing advanced looms and storerooms. Textile output is at its peak, supporting trade and population.
Cloth Guildhall
A permanent wooden and brick hall, the seat of the weavers guild. Oversees all textile production, training, and trade, cementing the clans prosperity.
Indian Weaver Guild
A prestigious, multi-generational guild of Indian weavers, famed throughout the steppes. Facilitates unparalleled textile production, trade, and clan unity.
